options: Hairstyle Analysis: Create a clean, modern hairstyle analysis graphic using this portrait. Show side-by-side hairstyles comparisons to highlight which hairstyles suit the subject best. Make it visual-first, with short labels only and no paragraphs. Use a minimal, premium style: neutral background.

Animal Infographic: Create a visually rich infographic about an endangered animal. Start by finding one online, research its habitat, diet, and unique traits. Present information through annotated visuals and structured callouts, not generic sections. Style it like a bold graphic illustration: a detailed, photorealistic central animal as the focal point, supported by diagrams, callouts, and concise text elements. Use clean backgrounds and a mix of photorealism with strong graphic elements (shapes, icons, color blocking) in a layered composition. Make it dense, tactile, and professionally authored.

Research Visual: Create a deeply researched editorial-style infographic that transforms a highly complex topic into something understandable. Use premium visual design: a clean grid layout, bold typography, subtle gradients, a refined color palette, elegant icons, data visualizations, layered diagrams, and clear hierarchy. Prioritize peer-reviewed articles and respected publications as references. Make it as rich and amazing as possible for this topic:

Hand Written: Add a hand drawn overlay on top of the image. Final output should be stylish, relaxed and effortlessly casual. Drawing rules: Use thin, hand-drawn lines as if drawn with a white pen. Keep it in a single-stroke style: rough and slightly uneven. Add outlines tracing around the outer edges of objects. Use arrows or dotted lines to guide the viewer’s eye. Text rules: Handwritten text. Keep it short, like a casual inner monologue. Tone: diary-like, brief, and emotion-focused. Commentary should be positive and sweet. Decorations: Add steam, sparkles, hearts, small emoticon-like faces sparingly. Avoid overdoing it; leave some “negative space”.

Surreal: Create an image where one element of the subject or scene transforms into a whimsical, silly surreal phenomenon that reimagines a conceptual rule (causality, identity, perception, or spatial logic), avoiding natural effects. The transformation should be intrinsically tied to the subject, blending the absurd with everyday reality to produce a striking, imaginative, and eccentric scene. The boundary between subject and transformation should feel merged or in tension. The subject's reaction should enhance cohesion.

Underwater: Create an extreme close-up underwater portrait after the subject has just jumped into a swimming pool or clear shallow water. Keep the mood calm, weightless, and ethereal, emphasizing light reflections. No struggle or urgency. Incredible, beautiful, effortless, smooth, calm

Hyper Wallpaper: Create a macro nature image of a scene with realistic textures, shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh, in a natural outdoor setting. The image has an analog, imperfect, wabi sabi, 35mm film-like quality—grain, natural color rendering, and a soft contrast curve. Ultra-realistic detail, macro photography, 9:16 aspect ratio. Before creating the image, ask me a follow up question giving a numbered list of a few unexpected options for subject matter and then render the image.

Cross-section: Transform the main subject of the uploaded image into a clean educational cutaway diagram on a white background. Keep the subject’s distinctive features from the original image, show a believable cross-section or layered interior, and add clear labeled callouts. Make it look like a textbook or museum science graphic, with clarity and accuracy prioritized over dramatic or artistic styling.

App Design: Create a 5.5x3 mockup image of a new design-forward app with a cohesive design system. Show one mobile welcome screen with no photography, one mobile home-page screen, and two product or service pages. Include nothing else in the mockup image. Before generating, ask me the name of my app, what it is for, and the aesthetic I want.

Illustrated Recipe: Create a 3-page color mixed media food zine for an international recipe. First, look online for recent trendy recipes, then choose one based on what you know about me. Include necessary step-by-step visuals, diagrams, and explainers. Include any health or environmental context of the dish.
